# Series B

Map of content for the round. Aleks runs it. I own the engineering, security and compliance story, and the truth underneath it.

## Status (Oct 9)

- Term sheet from Northfield Ventures (Ravi Menon) on Sep 22: **$38M at $210M post.** Granite Peak takes pro-rata.
- Technical diligence call with Elena Sorensen on **Oct 14.**
- Data room eng section due **Oct 12**: architecture narrative, scale metrics, security policies, SOC 2 status letter. Narrative v2 done-ish; status letter not started.
- Board meeting **Oct 21**. Eng section of the deck due **Oct 17.**
- Target close **Nov 14.**
- Numbers I'll use (Sep): 151k MAU, 101k MTU, $5.3M subscription ARR, $540k/mo burn, 15 months runway pre-close. May was 120k / 78k / $4.1M / $480k / 19.

Risk: Sep 26 and the GA slip land in diligence as questions instead of answers. Lead with them.
